result:
Task complete. Summary:

**Root cause found:** `buildProductNodes()` in `src/lib/services/capability-tree-service.ts` sourced the VERI ERP chain-selector's "Product" branch from `products`/`projects` — an unrelated PMS product-line/project grouping table — instead of `erpItems`, the actual ERP sellable-item master (item_code, selling rate, stock/HSN fields). That's why selecting Product surfaced Project records and project-management actions instead of product ones; Customer/Vendor were already wired correctly to `erpCustomers`/`erpSuppliers`.

**Fix applied:** `buildProductNodes()` now queries `erpItems` and attaches a new `GENERIC_PRODUCT_ACTIONS` leaf set ("Update price/stock", "Create a quotation"), mirroring the existing Customer/Vendor pattern. Removed the now-dead `genericProjectActions()` helper and cleaned up stale comments.

**Verified:** `tsc --noEmit` clean, full test suite 2216/2216 passing (9 new regression tests), lint clean, and confirmed `demo_project_website` isn't hardcoded anywhere in source.

**PR opened (not merged):** https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/607 — awaiting the required fresh supervisor audit per task governance.
